changeSet.author: nexus-rfvyy.6.3
changeSet.comment: Adds nexus.catalog_documents.sensitive BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false (RDR-243: the one-way document sensitivity flag) and idx_catalog_documents_sensitive_live, a partial index on (tenant_id, physical_collection) WHERE sensitive AND deleted_at IS NULL. An additive ADD COLUMN (no data mutation of any existing row; every existing document reads false), so no DATA EFFECT line applies per scripts/data_effect_lint.py's own scope.

rollback.sql: DROP INDEX IF EXISTS nexus.idx_catalog_documents_sensitive_live; ALTER TABLE nexus.catalog_documents DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS sensitive;

changeSet.author: nexus-rfvyy.6.3
changeSet.comment: Creates nexus.catalog_sensitivity_changes (RDR-243: the audit record of every change of catalog_documents.sensitive: tenant_id, tumbler, old, new, reason, actor, changed_at) with tenant RLS (ENABLE + FORCE + tenant_isolation) like its neighbours. A new table, so no data mutation of existing rows.

rollback.sql: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS tenant_isolation ON nexus.catalog_sensitivity_changes; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS nexus.catalog_sensitivity_changes;

changeSet.author: nexus-rfvyy.6.3
changeSet.comment: nexus.chunk_sensitive(tenant, collection, chash) and nexus.chunk_sensitive_many(tenant, collection, chashes) (RDR-243): true when any live owner of the chunk, joined through catalog_document_chunks, is sensitive. LANGUAGE sql, STABLE, SECURITY INVOKER, so RLS applies. Two new functions and their GRANT EXECUTE; no data effect: function definitions only.
